artifact.question: Is the frozen cycle02 candidate safe and portable for its stated development-review scope?

Make review links resolve and ensure render-only stage geometry is excluded by the eventual exporter.
Do not claim browser portability, release, runtime replacement, fabrication, or owner artistic acceptance without direct evidence.

claims.claim: The frozen candidate and referenced source binaries are intact and traceable.
claims.evidence: All 23 manifest file SHA-256 values matched. The source builder blend, locked canon composite, and July head reference matched their recorded SHA-256 values. Candidate receipts identify the shared goal revision and mark registration as estimated and artistic acceptance as not claimed.
claims.consequence: Hash mismatch or source substitution would invalidate this review packet.
claims.next_test: Recheck manifest hashes after any revision.

claims.claim: The new candidate remains outside the public/runtime path and respects the creative-content boundary.
claims.evidence: New files are under assets/audit/ and assets/models/; no cycle02 paths were found in src/ or public/. NOTICE.md and asset guidance state MurderBird creative content is all rights reserved and MIT covers code only. V37/runtime and release claims are not supported by this candidate.
claims.consequence: Moving or wiring these assets into public delivery without separate review could expose creative material and imply a release.
claims.next_test: If runtime integration is later proposed, inspect the exact build output and release authorization.

claims.claim: The contact ground is excluded from the eventual exporter by the authoringGuide filter.
claims.evidence: cg-supervised-lighting02.stage marks the plane authoringGuide=true; build-cg-supervised02 hides guides for rendering, while cg-supervised-export excludes authoringGuide meshes in both exporter paths. The surface02 receipt reports export_excluded=true.
claims.consequence: A future exporter path that omits this filter could include the review floor.
claims.next_test: Exercise the current scene through Blender export and verify the GLB has no stage object.

claims.claim: The native candidate's textures are portable and the HTML review page renders correctly.
claims.evidence: Authoring code packs FILE images before saving and finish generation packs new images; the review page's relative image/link targets all resolve on disk. Blender is unavailable here, so packed-image persistence/reopen and exporter embedding were not tested. review.html appends the cycle02 section after an explicit closing html tag; browser error recovery and visibility were not tested.
claims.consequence: A moved/reopened native file or browser review could lose texture/render visibility despite successful source-side receipts.
claims.next_test: Open the frozen .blend files in Blender in a clean checkout, verify packed images, run/export GLB and inspect embedded textures plus ground exclusion; render review.html in a browser and confirm the appended section is visible.

material_findings: Relative review-page image and link targets all resolve to existing files.
Review-page cycle02 markup follows an explicit </html> end tag; normalize markup and perform browser visibility check before relying on the page as a review interface.
No new cycle02 app/runtime wiring or browser-parity proof is present.
limits: Approve only as a local development/review candidate and matched-render evidence packet.
Do not claim portable native textures, browser parity, three-era delivery, deployment, final likeness, engineering validation, or owner acceptance from this review.
Canonical deployed/runtime baseline remains V37; no publication/runtime replacement authorization is established.
strongest_objection: Texture packing and eventual GLB embedding/exclusion are supported by source code and receipts but have not been exercised on reopen/export; review-page browser visibility is also unverified.
next_gaps: Blender reopen check for packed textures, followed by GLB export inspection for embedded image data and ground exclusion.
Browser render check of review.html, including its post-</html> cycle02 section.
If runtime/browser delivery is later proposed, add explicit wiring and test the actual build output; current candidate has no cycle02 runtime wiring.
